segments.name: Upstream
segments.description: Develops and produces natural gas, NGLs and oil from proved reserves, primarily in the Marcellus Shale of the Appalachian Basin.
segments.evidence: Primarily sales of natural gas, NGLs and oil and gains on derivatives.

segments.name: Gathering
segments.description: Gathers natural gas for the Upstream segment and third parties under long-term gathering agreements.
segments.evidence: Our Gathering segment has gathering agreements with our Upstream segment and with third parties.

segments.name: Transmission
segments.description: Provides natural gas transmission and storage services to the Upstream segment and third parties including local distribution companies and marketers.
segments.evidence: Our Transmission segment has transmission and storage agreements with our Upstream segment and with third parties.

revenueModel.text: EQT earns revenue primarily from selling natural gas, NGLs and oil, and from pipeline revenues charged to its Upstream segment and third parties for gathering, transmission and storage services.
revenueModel.evidence: (a) Primarily sales of natural gas, NGLs and oil and gains on derivatives. (b) Primarily pipeline revenues.
